fluid_baseline: Toyota Genuine ATF WS; confirm exact donor service specification
assumptions: All conductances/resistances, oil properties, external flow, pump heat and planning bands are engineering assumptions, not measured WS/P112/cooler specifications
Winding-to-oil and winding-to-casing paths are distinct from the previous lumped winding resistance and must not be added to it
A single well-mixed bulk oil node misses compartment gradients, jet distribution, aeration and local bearing/magnet hotspots
Cooler effectiveness uses a counterflow heat exchanger with the configured coolant flow available at its branch; a parallel branch may have less flow
No viscosity-loss or pump-pressure model: this analysis compares thermal feasibility, not a proven energy optimum
Planning temperatures are proposed commissioning targets, not OEM trips or controller settings
